lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Tom Schubert is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Tom is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Tom Schubert is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Tom kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Tom's gone." Catalina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Tom." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Claudine blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Small Unit Tactics (Level 1). Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Tom Schubert, 41 days. The mantle passes to Claudine Nyembo.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Claudine Nyembo, 54 — a Police officer. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, War Cry, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Tom — and Tom is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Regina, Fatima, Benoit and 3 more speak for Claudine — "Tom trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Claudine before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
